description: This Java source file defines the ActivityHelper class, an Android activity that triggers speech recognition via RecognizerIntent, handles the recognition results, and communicates the results back through a ServiceBridge.

classes.name: ActivityHelper
classes.description: An Android activity that initiates speech recognition, processes the results, and communicates with a ServiceBridge.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the speech recognition intent, and starts the recognition activity.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from the speech recognition activity, processes the recognition results, and displays dialogs or notifies the ServiceBridge.

methods.name: createResultDialog
methods.description: Creates an AlertDialog to display multiple recognition results for user selection.

methods.name: notifyResult
methods.description: Sends the recognition result to the ServiceBridge and finishes the activity.
